Are you a fabricator / welder looking for a greater technical challenge? Read on! For one of our clients near Venray, we are looking for a fabricator / welder. In this challenging role, you will work together with your colleagues on the most spectacular curved structures and construction projects around the world. Wie zoeken we? What do you need to get started as a fabricator / welder? Experience as a fabricator / welder is preferred. However, if you do not have direct experience but possess solid technical knowledge, the company is willing to train you on the job. Technical aptitude and understanding of fabrication processes MIG/MAG welding certification is an advantage Available to work full-time in a day shift Good command of Dutch, English, or German Living in or nearby Venray We are preferably looking for someone with experience as a fabricator / welder, but candidates without experience are also encouraged to apply. If you have a strong technical background and a willingness to learn, the rest can be taught in the workplace. Wat bieden wij je? What can you expect as a fabricator / welder? A gross monthly salary between €2,800 and €3,600, depending on your experience and qualifications Travel expense reimbursement A challenging position within a growing and innovative company A full-time day shift role Strong focus on personal growth and professional development This is an excellent opportunity to join a dynamic organization where you will work on unique and technically demanding projects while continuing to develop your skills and expertise. Functieomschrijving As a fabricator / welder, you will drill, bend, saw, and assemble curved components for a wide range of projects, including architectural structures, heavy offshore constructions, complex 3D roller coaster frameworks, and more. This is a full-time daytime position, with working hours from 07:15 to 16:10 o'clock. Your responsibilities as a Fabricator/Welder include: Reading and interpreting technical

drawings Independently carrying out various fabrication tasks, such as drilling, bending, sawing, and welding curved components Moving and positioning products using lifting equipment and hoisting tools Interested? Are you ready for a greater technical challenge and would like to work as a fabricator / welder? Apply today via the application button, or contact our office in Venray at +31 (0)478 799 010 for more information.

 Wat ga je doen? 
Are you creative enough to source parts that almost no one else can find? 
As a Purchasing Officer, you are responsible for sourcing all required parts for a single aircraft, from A to Z. This is not a role focused on routine purchasing or recurring orders. In addition, you will meet with clients once or twice a week to provide updates on part availability and sourcing progress. This role requires persistence, creativity, strong communication skills, and the ability to think beyond conventional procurement methods to keep aircraft flying. 
 Waar ga je werken? 
You'll be working for a leading, independent aircraft maintenance organization in the Maastricht region. You'll be working right alongside the aircraft, as part of an international team with short lines of communication. It's a full-time position.

Looking for a stable production job with good pay in a technical environment? We are hiring Production Employees– Mold Lines for MGG in Tegelen. You will work in the casting department, where molds are produced for high-quality aluminum parts used in automotive, energy, and medical industries. This is a full-time job in a 2-shift system, excluding night shifts. The basic hourly wage is €16.06. You will receive a 116% bonus for all hours worked, whether you work early, late, or night shifts. €16.06 x 116% = €18.63. On top of that, you will also receive €0.91 in ADV per hour worked: €18.63 + €0.91 = €19.54 gross per hour.
